table.name: Cartoon
table.purpose: Episode list for the animated series 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold' (each row is one episode, with title, director, writer, air date, production code, and the TV channel it aired on).

col_002.name: episode_title
col_002.description: Episode title, e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!', 'Fall of the Blue Beetle!' — all Batman: The Brave and the Bold episode titles.

col_003.name: director
col_003.description: Episode director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang).

col_004.name: writer
col_004.description: Episode writer(s), e.g. J. M. DeMatteis, Steven Melching, Joseph Kuhr.

col_005.name: original_air_date
col_005.description: Original US air date stored as text without spaces, e.g. 'November21,2008', 'January23,2009'.

col_006.name: production_code
col_006.description: Production code of the episode (101-112), sequential with episode number.

col_007.name: channel_id
col_007.description: Foreign key to TV_Channel.col_001 identifying the channel the episode aired on (values 700-728 map to music/TV channels such as MTV Hits, MTV Dance). The pairing of a Batman cartoon with music channels is odd, but the join is statistically accepted; the semantic link is unresolved.

table.name: TV_Channel
table.purpose: A catalogue of music TV channels (mostly on the Sky Italy platform), one row per channel, referenced by TV_series and Cartoon tables.

col_001.name: channel_id
col_001.description: Primary key; numeric channel identifier (likely the channel number on the platform, 700-728), stored as text. Referenced by TV_series.col_009 and Cartoon.col_007.

col_002.name: channel_name
col_002.description: Unique human-readable name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits', 'MTV Dance').

col_003.name: country
col_003.description: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

col_004.name: language
col_004.description: Primary broadcast language of the channel (Italian, English); consistent with the country column.

col_005.name: genre
col_005.description: Content genre of the channel; constant value 'music' for all rows.

col_006.name: aspect_ratio
col_006.description: Picture aspect ratio of the broadcast: '4:3', '16:9', or '4:3 / 16:9' (both available).

col_007.name: is_hd
col_007.description: Yes/no flag; only one channel differs. Plausibly indicates whether the channel is broadcast in HD (or some other channel attribute such as 'is_new'); the specific attribute cannot be confirmed from values alone.

col_009.name: package
col_009.description: Pay-TV package/bundle in which the channel is offered on the Sky platform: 'Sky Famiglia', 'Sky Famiglia + Sky HD', 'Option', or 'no ( FTV )' meaning free-to-view.

table.name: TV_series
table.purpose: Episode-level records for a 2007 American TV series (episode titles and air dates match the 2007 series 'Journeyman'): one row per episode, with title, original air date, and audience measurement figures. The joins to Cartoon are almost certainly spurious statistical matches, not real relationships.

col_001.name: episode_id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential episode number (1-12), one row per episode.

col_002.name: episode_title
col_002.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback'); unique per row.

col_003.name: original_air_date
col_003.description: Original U.S. broadcast date of the episode, stored as text in 'Month DD, YYYY' format; all values fall in October-December 2007, consistent with a weekly series.

col_006.name: rating_share
col_006.description: Nielsen-style rating/share pair written as 'R/S' (e.g. '2.4/6', '3.2/8'): household rating points over share of viewing audience. The two components also independently match the ranges of col_004 (rating) and col_005 (share), suggesting col_004/col_005 are the split-out rating and share values.

col_007.name: viewers_millions
col_007.description: Audience size in millions of viewers (4.24-9.16), consistent with U.S. broadcast ratings for a 2007 network drama. The one-to-one join to Cartoon.col_001 is spurious and should be ignored.

col_009.name: channel_code
col_009.description: Channel identifier referencing TV_Channel.col_001 (numeric codes 700-728 mapping to music/TV channels such as 'MTV Hits', 'MTV Dance'). Values stored as text; indicates the channel on which the episode was broadcast/listed.
